annotation.audio: A short, upbeat chiptune-style music loop featuring a bright, arpeggiated synth melody, a simple bass line, and a steady electronic drum beat (kick, snare/clap, hi-hat). The tone is clean, digital, and energetic, with no vocals or speech.
annotation.visual: A video-game style contact sheet: three horizontal dark-gray bands across the frame, each labeled with a time range in the format 'Xs|Ys' (e.g., '100s|0.00s', '+0.33s|0.33s', '+0.67s|0.67s' on the top band; '+1.00s|1.00s', '+1.33s|1.33s', '+1.67s|1.67s' on the middle band; '+2.00s|2.00s', '+2.33s|2.33s', '+2.67s|2.67s' on the bottom band). The background is solid blue, and the bands are evenly spaced with no visible people, icons, or actions.

cross_modal.description: Three time-labeled dark bands arranged left-to-right and top-to-bottom on a solid blue background, resembling a game contact sheet or level indicator.
Upbeat chiptune music loop with synth melody, bass, and drum beat, playing continuously throughout the clip.
